name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 5 visits over 68 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.8 days starting 2026-04-27, at wavelengths from 0.86 to 4.32 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
